_doc: The HydroRIVERS network cut to the map's window at flow class <= 4, with eight of its fields kept under their upstream names. NEXT_DOWN is the network: 0 is the sea, an id not in this file is a smaller channel below the cut. TAINTED=1 marks a reach downstream of a blast site and LOAD is what it still carries, 1 at the crater and divided by discharge wherever the water gets bigger, until it falls under a twentieth; both absent means clean. Regenerate with tools/build-hydrography.py; do not hand-patch.
